_header: The home page's feature cards (site.js renderHome reads this file; scripts/test_site.js checks it).
Each feature: id, audience (an id of `audiences`), title (a few words), text (one sentence), status, source,
and optionally link (a #/ route of the site or an https URL) and image (a picture the repository already has).
status 'available': released in the extension and firmware named by `released` below (on origin/main).
status 'release': built, in vscode-evn-alpha/CHANGELOG.md's '## Unreleased' (m2); it carries `release`, the
version it ships in, and shows 'Coming soon' until `released` reaches that version.
status 'planned': an item of docs/session/2026-10-31_ccr-od-review/PLAN_2027.md with a design or a lane behind it;
it shows 'Coming soon'. Never a date, and nothing that is neither built nor planned.
source: where the claim is recorded (the CHANGELOG section, a done-file, or PLAN_2027's item).
THE ONE EDIT AT A RELEASE: when 0.2.76 is published, change "released": "0.2.75" to "released": "0.2.76".
Done for 0.2.76 (2026-11-11, px13g76): released set, and since the release folds the CHANGELOG's ## Unreleased into ## 0.2.76, its release items became available, citing ## 0.2.76.
Every feature with "release": "0.2.76" then shows 'Available now'; nothing else changes. A later release
moves its own items to `release` and repeats the edit with its version.
A 'Coming soon' item the owner strikes (docs/session/2026-11-10_site76/owner_items.md) is deleted here.
